taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Git submodule revision/source trust in a privileged build
controls.source_trace: Trace who can change the submodule URL/revision and whether the approved parent revision actually binds the bytes later built.
controls.implementation_branch: Bind .gitmodules URL changes, the committed gitlink SHA, recursive submodules and any update --remote behavior. A pinned SHA narrows content identity but does not prove an approved producer or safe build scripts. Rewriting a local URL is privileged fixture setup unless the protected build actually consumes an attacker-editable configuration source.
controls.controlled_verification: Use inert owned repositories and a local checkout; compare pinned intended content with an untrusted URL/ref update without running builds.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: The presence of submodules is not a supply-chain flaw; approved immutable submodule content can be valid.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind submodule source and revision to reviewed provenance, retesting recursive updates and approved release behavior.
